lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Duc Steele is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Duc Steele is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Duc kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Duc's gone." Cesar looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Duc." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
